# Decouvertes Future Tech

> Decouvertes Future Tech Private Limited is an Indian drone manufacturer and defence-technology company in Pune, Maharashtra, founded in 2023 and recognised by DPIIT (Startup India). It designs, builds and tests indigenous UAVs, ground-control software and field communication devices for defence, government, surveillance, mapping and industrial inspection.

## Drones
- [Vision Nano](https://www.decouvertes.in/products/vision-nano.html): 250 g nano surveillance drone, 20 MP camera, 5 km range, 25 min flight time
- [Vision 1.0](https://www.decouvertes.in/products/vision-1.html): 1.8 kg carbon-fibre training quadcopter
- [Vision 2.0](https://www.decouvertes.in/products/vision-2.html): foldable surveillance quadcopter with PTZ camera, GPS-denied navigation and AI autonomy, 25 km range
- [Vision 3.0](https://www.decouvertes.in/products/vision-3.html): VTOL fixed-wing UAV, 50 km range, 45 min endurance
- [Vision 4.0](https://www.decouvertes.in/products/vision-4.html): X8 coaxial heavy-payload drone, 5 kg payload, 50 min flight time, 35 km range
- [All products](https://www.decouvertes.in/products/)

## Capabilities and software
- [Custom UAV development and drone manufacturing](https://www.decouvertes.in/custom-uav-development.html): custom UAV design, airframes, flight control, payload, navigation and communication integration
- [Drone capabilities](https://www.decouvertes.in/solutions.html): surveillance, mapping, inspection, disaster response, GPS-denied navigation, DOAF, AI vision, swarm, tethered and training drones
- [Software](https://www.decouvertes.in/software/): ground control station and companion apps
